# MTK SH

> Independent iOS apps by MTK SH. Official app descriptions, support guides, and privacy policies.

Website languages: Japanese (ja), English (en), Simplified Chinese (zh-Hans). Website translations do not imply the app supports those languages. Release availability is stated per app; do not assume an app under review is downloadable. Contact: support@mtk.sh.

## Apps

- [ThreeAims](https://yu-kitazume-apps.u-kitazume.chatgpt.site/en/apps/threeaims/): A tiny habit assistant. Choose three daily aims and make a little progress with a 5, 10, or 25-minute focus session. Status: released.
- [DaySlice](https://yu-kitazume-apps.u-kitazume.chatgpt.site/en/apps/dayslice/): See a day as one turn of Earth. A gentle visualization of time, with daily check-ins, widgets, and the weather. Status: released.
- [V-Type](https://yu-kitazume-apps.u-kitazume.chatgpt.site/en/apps/v-type/): One drop of water against a world-spanning fleet. A portrait sci-fi action game of momentum, precision, and the instant you break through. Status: released.
- [Frames](https://yu-kitazume-apps.u-kitazume.chatgpt.site/en/apps/frames/): Organize ideas with 67 thinking frameworks, from SWOT and priorities to reflection. Capture what matters and decide on your next step. Status: in-review.
- [What I Wanted to Say (WIWS)](https://yu-kitazume-apps.u-kitazume.chatgpt.site/en/apps/wiws/): Start with a diary in Japanese, write your own English, then learn from AI corrections, explanations in Japanese, and up to three phrase cards. Status: in-review.
